boundary: Real Obsidian opens the default browser to a controlled authorization endpoint; later consent uses captured browser-open intent and native URI dispatch. Browser external-app confirmation UI remains unverified.
checks: Original window.open launches the native default browser and reaches the authorization endpoint without exchanging a token; external-app confirmation UI remains unverified
OAuth cancellation, PKCE exchange, state and OS URI handler
Bearer survives entry redirect; pagination includes read articles; repeat sync creates no duplicates or Markdown fetches; existing note preserved
Reader edits protected; reader rename remains tracked; server rename updates Obsidian links; deleted notes stay deleted; removed saves keep their notes
Secret storage survives process restart; naturally expired fixture access token refreshes without a new login
Rate limiting is reported and a later sync succeeds
Sign-out revokes credentials and retains notes; server revocation returns plugin to signed-out state
